description: This PHP class defines the OAuthClient entity for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_oauth2_client' database table. It includes properties such as id, name, clientId, clientSecret, redirectUri, confidential, and enabled, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OAuthClient
classes.description: Represents an OAuth 2.0 client configuration entity with properties such as client ID, secret, redirect URI, and confidentiality settings.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID used in OAuth authentication.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Returns the client secret associated with the OAuth client.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI for OAuth flows.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Indicates if the client is confidential.

methods.name: setConfidential
methods.description: Sets the confidentiality status of the client.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the OAuth client is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the OAuth client.
